name: c-gantt-1
title: Gantt chart with settings menu and schedulable rows
label: Settings Menu
description: Gantt chart with settings menu and schedulable rows

guidance.bestFor: A tabbed Settings popover with 12 display and behavior switches, 6 languages and 5 time zones, over empty rows waiting to be scheduled
agentNotes: `handleSelectSlot` adds the scheduled bar with `addEvent` and saves nothing; send the slot to your API there
Right to left comes from `dir` on the wrapping div, which `Gantt` inherits; set it on your own layout for Arabic
`SettingsMenu` and the 14 `useState` hooks feeding it only demo the props; pass the values you want straight to `Gantt`

whenNotToUse.when: A lean starting point with no settings panel to strip out

name: c-gantt-2
title: Gantt chart with drag-to-reorder tree rows
label: Drag Reorder
description: Gantt chart with drag-to-reorder tree rows

guidance.bestFor: The leanest setup, where one callback adds a drag grip to every tree row and a single setState keeps the new order
agentNotes: The row grip shows only when `onResourceReorder` is passed, and `resources` must be state it updates or a drop changes nothing

whenNotToUse.when: Records dragged into a new order in a table with no dates

name: c-gantt-3
title: Gantt chart with quarter roadmap and rollups
label: Quarter Roadmap
description: Gantt chart with quarter roadmap and rollups

guidance.bestFor: Multi month initiatives grouped by workstream, with a toolbar button that drops the next backlog item onto its empty row
agentNotes: Each `BACKLOG` id must match an empty row in `RESOURCES`, since `addInitiative` uses it as the new bar's `resourceId`

whenNotToUse.when: A single week of assignments per person rather than a year of initiatives

name: c-gantt-4
title: Gantt chart with weekly capacity board
label: Capacity Board
description: Gantt chart with weekly capacity board

guidance.bestFor: Teammates grouped by squad with avatar row labels and shaded weekends, where added assignments stack into extra lanes
agentNotes: `resourceMeta` maps each row id to initials and a `randomuser.me` photo, since `GanttResource` takes no custom fields
`addAssignment` is a demo stub that cycles `PEOPLE` and `TASK_POOL`; swap in your own booking flow

whenNotToUse.when: Owner and status columns beside each task in a report that cannot be dragged

name: c-gantt-5
title: Gantt chart with task table and progress
label: Task Table
description: Gantt chart with task table and progress

guidance.bestFor: A read only status report whose tree panel adds Owner avatars and Status badges as columns, with rows added from the toolbar
agentNotes: Owner and Status cells read the `meta` state by row id, so a row added without a `meta` entry renders empty cells
Drag, resize and slot selection are off through `defaultInteractions`, so bars change only through `addTask`

whenNotToUse.when: A plan whose bars should be dragged and resized on the chart

name: c-gantt-6
title: Gantt chart with as-built baseline tracking
label: Baseline Tracking
description: Gantt chart with as-built baseline tracking

guidance.bestFor: Frozen plan dates ghosted behind actual bars, showing early, late and on time work plus a planned band on a whole group
agentNotes: Rows come from `buildResources`, which also dates the Implementation group's planned band around the current week
Give a bar both `baselineStart` and `baselineEnd` or neither; equal values draw a planned milestone diamond

whenNotToUse.when: Tasks chained by arrows from each predecessor into the next

name: c-gantt-7
title: Gantt chart with dependency arrows and milestones
label: Dependencies & Milestones
description: Gantt chart with dependency arrows and milestones

guidance.bestFor: A rollout chain where QA waits on 2 build tracks and a zero length sign off gate opens the go live step
agentNotes: `dependencies` holds predecessor bar ids such as `bar-kickoff`, not row ids, so keep them in step with each bar's `id`
Arrows only draw: moving a bar never shifts the bars after it, so reschedule dependents in `onEventUpdate`

whenNotToUse.when: Actual dates compared against a frozen plan for each task
